Priya CS: FYI HawkMed dropped their vendor security form and circled two hot items: embeddings encryption at rest, and a required subprocessor list for renewal. They want a single doc packet by Thu COB.
Ethan - Sec: I can confirm AES-256 at rest for stored embeddings. Need infra to confirm key provenance for hosted tenants.
Nate (onboard): Uploading the form & current subprocessor list to the account folder. Link: https://files.redwood/hawkmed/vendor-form-2024.pdf
Marta - Legal: I'll check the contract clause they referenced re: subprocessors. If they insist on a signed subprocessor addendum, that adds lead time.
Felix AE: HawkMed scope includes EU data; they're specifically asking if embeddings ever leave region for cold storage. That's a renewal risk for them.
eng-bot: Ticket created: CS-1892 "HawkMed: vendor form + embeddings residency" assigned to Priya CS.
Ethan - Sec: Quick snippet to include in packet: ```
- Encryption: AES-256 (at rest), TLS1.2+ in transit
- Key management: KMS-wrapped keys, customer BYOK not available on hosted by default
```
Priya CS: Nate, can you confirm whether embeddings cold-tiering moves objects to a global bucket or keeps regional shards?
Nate (onboard): Short answer: cold-tier is cross-region for cost optimization. We can opt a tenant to region-lock by request but it's manual and may impact TCO. Documenting now.
Marta - Legal: Also check HawkMed asked about deletion proof on termination. We should provide the retention + deletion workflow and evidence types (audit log entries, job run IDs).
Ethan - Sec: We'll include a sample audit log line format they can expect. Example: "DELETE_RETENTION_JOB account=hawkm-123 job_id=job_20240503-07 status=completed"
Felix AE: Can we offer a migration path if they require BYOK? They prefer not to move to Dedicated but might if contractually required. Add an estimate for timeline and cost.
Priya CS: Action list: Ethan 1: encryption + sample log; Marta 1: legal wording and subprocessor addendum options; Nate 1: residency/cold-tier note and manual region-lock steps; Felix 1: draft migration estimate. Aim to assemble one PDF.
eng-bot: Reminder: SLA for responses logged under CS-1892 is 72 hours.
Priya CS: Let's meet tomorrow 10am PT for a quick packet review. Calendar invite sent. If anyone can't make, post quick comments here. :calendar:
Marta - Legal: Will try to make it; otherwise I'll post redlines before the meeting.
Ethan - Sec: I'll upload the encryption proof and sample logs to the ticket by EOD today.
Nate (onboard): Uploaded residency note to CS-1892. Includes manual opt-in steps and expected lead time (2-3 days).
Felix AE: Putting together a cost ballpark for BYOK migration and Dedicated onboarding; will post before the review.
Priya CS: Great work — thanks team. If HawkMed pushes the deadline we'll escalate to Sales + Solutions. :thumbsup:
